blocks.content: Quiz: In the Rapid Building methodology, which phase comes before writing any code?
Tap an option below to answer:
Installing dependencies and setting up the development environment
Setup is part of the pre-build checklist, but it comes after planning, design, and prompt architecture are already done.
Setup is part of the pre-build checklist, but it comes after planning, design, and prompt architecture are already done.
Defining the product, brand guidelines, and prompt architecture
Correct. All decisions - product definition, brand, design, and prompt structure - are locked before a single line of code is written. This is the core of the methodology.
Correct. All decisions - product definition, brand, design, and prompt structure - are locked before a single line of code is written. This is the core of the methodology.
Running Claude Code with an initial draft prompt
Running Claude Code is a build-phase action. It comes after the planning and design phases are complete.
Running Claude Code is a build-phase action. It comes after the planning and design phases are complete.
Deploying to Netlify to establish the live URL
Netlify is connected during pre-build setup, but deploying comes after building. The planning phase still precedes it.
Netlify is connected during pre-build setup, but deploying comes after building. The planning phase still precedes it.
